title: add-cosign-signing-provenance-and-release-manifests-for-private-installer-ci
author: Marina Patel
description: Add CI steps and release artifacts to produce signed release manifests and provenance for Private Installer releases. This PR introduces a GitHub Actions workflow (+ reusable job) that builds installer artifacts (helm charts, terraform modules, installer binary), generates SBOMs via Syft, records in-toto provenance metadata, and signs artifacts/manifests with Cosign (KMS-backed key). The goal is to provide verifiable release manifests consumers can use in air-gapped/private deployments and to satisfy enterprise compliance requirements. Changes include: 1) a new .github/workflows/release-manifests.yml workflow that runs on tag and manual dispatch, 2) reusable actions/jobs for build->sbom->provenance->sign->publish, 3) additions to release-manifests/ directory containing v1 manifest schema and templating scripts, 4) terraform module updates to include manifest references and manifest verification in deployment plans, 5) Helm chart annotations for signed provenance and SBOM links, 6) docs and runbook for key provisioning and rotation using GCP KMS or Vault, 7) tests and an integration job that validates signature verification and manifest integrity. Checklist: [x] build artifacts, [x] generate SBOMs, [x] produce in-toto provenance, [x] sign artifacts with Cosign (KMS), [x] publish manifests to release bucket, [x] terraform + helm references wired, [x] update docs/runbook. Non-goals: automated key escrow, long-term artifact retention policy. Migration notes: operators must provision a Cosign KMS key following docs/ops/cosign-kms.md before enabling the publish workflow.
